about: Every Turso database the platform's code names: what it is, what uses it, where it lives and which secret holds its token. Token values are never written here; `token` is the name of the secret that holds one. The Platform screen's stores section is drawn from this file. The test in stores.test.ts holds this list to the code that names the stores.

stores.name: fleet-queue
stores.title: Fleet queue
stores.does: The one fleet queue: the claims, leases and results the agents work from.

stores.name: fleet-platform
stores.title: Fleet platform
stores.does: The PM and dashboard plane: the agent mirror, quota, aggregator and ingest families, alerts and decision events.

stores.name: fleet-mirror
stores.title: Fleet mirror
stores.does: The lagging second copy of the agent mirror dataset, read by the quota check.

stores.name: voice-line-ledger
stores.title: Voice line ledger
stores.token: TURSO_TOKEN (a Worker secret, set by the deploy)
